_comment: Mutation testing config. Driven by scripts/mutants.mjs, which derives each run's scope from the `mutate` set below; a full sweep is the nightly job in .github/workflows/mutants.yaml. Doctrine: docs/developing/testing.md. No `coverageAnalysis`: the vitest runner forces `perTest` whatever this file says, so a value here would read as a decision nobody can act on - reaching for `"all"` to explain a survivor changes nothing.
_comment_workflows: The box workflow bodies are excluded because no test runs them; the argument for that, and the only statement of it, is beside the same path in vitest.config.ts's coverage exclusions. This is the last rung of the duplication ladder - Stryker reads JSON and cannot import that list - so tests/invariants/tests.test.ts pins the two entries together. The exclusion is honest only while those files stay wiring: a workflow body is `step.run*` calls in order, and every decision it makes belongs in a module it calls (snapshotPollOutcome, snapshotImagePollStatus, rollbackCaptureFailure, runtimeArtifactsForBox). Logic moved into one of these files is logic nothing can check.
